FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Your questions,
answered.

Let’s discuss the right packaging approach for your product and brand.

Ask us a question
How long does rigid-box production take?+

Timing depends on construction, materials, quantity and finishing. HotPrint will discuss a production schedule once the requirements and approval sample have been agreed.

Does HotPrint accept small quantities?+

Tell us your expected quantity and intended use. HotPrint will discuss an approach suited to the scale and requirements of your project.

Which paper materials are used?+

Rigid boxes combine a board core and an outer paper covering. Paper, thickness and surface are selected around the structure, contents and design.

Can the design be customised?+

Discuss dimensions, lids, internal inserts, covering and brand identity. Share a logo, content or reference sample to start the conversation.

How is the price calculated?+

Pricing depends on dimensions, construction, materials, finishing and quantity. Send a brief for advice and a quotation for your specific project.
